title: the dispatcher folder is not the project, so a worker the terminal puts there is refused even when the dialog shows
source: intended: TS-ODDITIES L4 (owner decision, defect N-22): the dispatcher folder leaves the allowed set once the dispatcher names the primary worktree (defect N-23)
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES L4, owner decision, defect N-22, with defect N-23). The dispatcher's launch line passes --worktree path:<primary>, so a launch has no reason to run in the dispatcher folder, and ~/.jitso/dispatch-cwd is no longer an allowed folder: Orca reporting it exits 2 with 'untrusted folder', closes the terminal, sends no key and writes no registry line. The TS binary trusts that folder, confirms the dialog and launches (exit 0).

screens:
Is this a project you created or one you trust?
 1. Yes, I trust this folder
 2. No, exit

stderr.contains: JITSO REJECTED: untrusted folder {{HOME}}/.jitso/dispatch-cwd: a launch runs only in a worktree of this repo
